spec.text: 2D hand-painted animation key frame, gouache and ink, visible brush texture, limited palette of deep teal, sand ochre and brass gold, graphic shapes, slight paper grain. A treasure hunter in her 30s, sun-worn linen shirt, leather satchel, short dark hair, steps from a wooden rowboat onto a wild volcanic island shore at golden hour and glances back over her shoulder toward the camera. In her hand an antique brass magnetic compass. Storm clouds breaking behind her. No text.
